artifacts.summary: Confirms the 10 silent implementation agents, flags 3 additional hard-mode agents outside the dispatch's literal grep with the same bug, and recommends reusing lint-agent-contracts.sh's canonical-fragment-plus-check pattern (Checks C/G/H) rather than ad hoc per-file wording.

memory_candidates.content: This repo propagates a MUST-DO/MUST-NOT bullet across a curated set of agent prompt files via a canonical fragment file under context/contracts/ (e.g. no-task-references-bullet.md) plus a matching lint-agent-contracts.sh Check (e.g. Check C) that greps every in-scope agent for the exact literal text. This exists because @-references inside an agent body do NOT auto-resolve when Claude Code spawns a subagent (proven empirically per no-task-references-bullet.md) -- so the fix must be a literal copy in every agent body, kept in sync by the lint rather than a shared @-import. Next available check letter: L (A,B,C,E,F,G,H,I,J,K implemented; D reserved/deferred).

modified_files (in an implementation agent's .return-meta.json) is NOT a record of every file the agent wrote. The task directory (specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/**) is already unconditionally staged by the implement commit scope regardless of this field. modified_files exists specifically for repo source files touched OUTSIDE the task directory (code, config, etc.) -- any wording that tells an agent to list its own summary/plan path here is a misreading of the contract.
